quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #6
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: An emergency vehicle is approaching you with its siren and flashing lights while you are in an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop immediately in the intersection until it passes.
Pull to the right of the intersection and stop.
Continue through the intersection, then pull to the right and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue through the intersection, then pull to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: If you are in an intersection when you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights or a siren, finish crossing the intersection. Then drive to the right and stop. You must give the right-of-way to police cars, fire trucks, ambulances, and other emergency vehicles using a siren or flashing lights.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Go 35 mph or slower as you approach the upcoming curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go 35 mph or slower as you approach the upcoming curve.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions ahead. These signs may show a recommended speed for the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers of a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What should you do at an intersection with a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Wait for the green light before going.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you must slow down and be careful. Watch for traffic and pedestrians crossing.

questions.question: On a slippery road, how should you adjust your following distance?

options.text: Keep it the same as normal.

questions.explanation: You need more distance to stop on a slippery road than on a dry road. Keep a longer distance between your car and the car ahead when driving on slippery roads.

questions.question: What does alcohol affect first?
questions.explanation: Alcohol reduces all the skills you need to drive safely. It goes from your stomach into your blood, then to other parts of your body. Alcohol affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and skill.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light at an intersection mean?

options.text: The same as a yield sign.
The light is about to turn green.
The same as a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must come to a complete stop. Yield to other traffic and pedestrians. Go when the way is clear. This is the same as a stop sign.

questions.question: You see pedestrians in a crosswalk ahead. What should you do?

options.text: Keep going. You have the right-of-way.
Wait for the pedestrians to cross.
Go around the pedestrians to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for the pedestrians to cross.
questions.explanation: You must let pedestrians in a crosswalk cross first. Wait until the intersection is clear before driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does an orange-colored sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mark construction areas. Drive with caution.

questions.question: If there is a deep puddle on the road ahead, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed and drive through the water.
Put the car in neutral while driving through the water.

questions.explanation: To avoid skidding, stay away from slippery areas like ice, wet leaves, oil, and deep puddles. Dry, solid surfaces are the safest for driving.

questions.question: Which statement is true about driving and taking medications?

options.text: Most cold medications can make you drowsy.
Over-the-counter medications are safe for driving at recommended doses.
Any medication prescribed by a doctor is safe to take while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Most cold medications can make you drowsy.
questions.explanation: All medications, prescription or over-the-counter, can be dangerous and affect your driving. Cold and allergy medicines can make you drowsy. Know how your medication affects your ability to drive.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roads where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to enter an expressway ramp going the wrong way.

questions.question: Give the right-of-way to any pedestrian who is:
questions.explanation: You must let pedestrians cross in marked or unmarked crosswalks. For safety, give pedestrians the right-of-way when they cross any street.

questions.question: Driving while taking medication that impairs your driving is permitted:
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive under the influence of any substance that affects your driving ability. This includes alcohol, prescription drugs, over-the-counter drugs, and illegal drugs.

questions.question: At dawn, dusk, rain, or snow, it is hard to see and be seen. The best way to let other drivers know you are there is to turn:
questions.explanation: Use your headlights whenever you cannot see other vehicles or when other drivers cannot see you. Use your low beam headlights whenever you need your windshield wipers.

questions.question: It is unlawful to:

options.text: Pass another vehicle in a marked no passing zone.
Pass another vehicle at a railroad crossing.

questions.explanation: You cannot cross the centerline to pass on hills, curves, or where you cannot see far enough ahead. Do not pass at intersections, railroad crossings, no passing zones, with solid yellow lines, when a car has stopped for a pedestrian, or in work zones.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles for any reason.

questions.question: If pedestrians are crossing illegally in the middle of the street instead of in a crosswalk, you:

options.text: Do not have to stop for them.
Should honk your horn at them.

questions.explanation: You must always give way to pedestrians. Even if they are jaywalking or crossing where they should not, you must still stop for them.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead turns sharply at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns you to slow down for a sharp change in direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A side road is entering from the left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Slow down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: If another car is passing you in a no passing zone, what should you do?

options.text: Keep your speed and position the same.
Slow down to let the other car safely return to your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to let the other car safely return to your lane.
questions.explanation: Help the passing car return to your lane safely and easily. This helps everyone avoid hazards ahead.

questions.question: You want to park uphill on a two-way road with no curb. Which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Right, toward the side of the road.
Left, toward the center of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right, toward the side of the road.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill or downhill on a road with no curb, turn your wheels so the car rolls away from the road center if the brakes fail.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.
Stop only if you need to.

questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until it is clear and safe for you to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: Your car's rear end starts skidding to the left. What should you do?

options.text: Tap your brakes lightly and shift into neutral.

questions.explanation: If your car skids, take your foot off the brake and steer in the direction you want to go. If the rear skids left, steer left. This straightens your car's direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: When the road is wet or icy, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Your tires grip the road less on wet or icy surfaces than on dry pavement. Slow down in these conditions.

questions.question: What does this yellow pennant-shaped sign say?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones.

questions.question: If you feel drowsy while driving, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Pull over at a rest stop or service area to nap, stretch, or let someone else drive. Caffeine pills are not a safe substitute for rest.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must stop completely at the marked stop line. Only proceed when it is safe. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop at the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Move to another lane if possible to give them space.
Traffic is merging from another road. Stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Move to another lane if possible to give them space.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will merge into your lane ahead. Check your mirrors and move to another lane if you can to give merging drivers a safe path.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has curves and turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers. This sign tells you the road will be slippery when wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: Why should you not use high beam headlights in fog or mist?

options.text: The light reflects back into your eyes.
Vehicles behind you may drive too close.

questions.correctAnswerText: The light reflects back into your eyes.
questions.explanation: In fog or mist, high beam headlights reflect the light back into your eyes, making it harder to see.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is not safe or legal to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: Which statement about blind spots is true?

options.text: Side mirrors eliminate all blind spots.
Large trucks have bigger blind spots than cars.
You can see all blind spots using your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Large trucks have bigger blind spots than cars.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see in your mirrors. Large trucks have much larger blind spots than regular cars. Other drivers should avoid these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal vehicle height in this state.
The maximum vehicle width allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It tells you how much space there is from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings are warnings. This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes.

questions.question: When you see a stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check only the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all other vehicles go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop. Look in all directions for traffic before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangle sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
